WITH RECURSIVE bom_parts(component_id) AS (
    SELECT b.component_id
    FROM product p
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-M21B-52'
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    SELECT b.component_id
    FROM bom_parts bp
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bp.component_id AND p.make_flag = true

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bp.component_id) AS distinct_part_count
FROM bom_parts bp
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bp.component_id
WHERE p.make_flag = false;

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE target AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'BK-R79Y-44'
),
bom_explode AS (
    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN target t ON b.assembly_id = t.product_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.component_id,
        e.qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bom_explode e
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id AND p.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = e.component_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(e.qty * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM bom_explode e
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id
WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the target product (one unit)
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        1.0::DOUBLE AS qty_per_unit
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R64Y-42'

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: expand current assemblies into their valid current components
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id,
        bt.qty_per_unit * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.product_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = bt.product_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(bt.qty_per_unit * p.standard_cost), 2), 0.00) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = bt.product_id
WHERE p.make_flag = false;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_bom AS (
    SELECT assembly_id, component_id, per_assembly_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials
    WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
explosion AS (
    -- Anchor: direct components of the target assembly
    SELECT cb.component_id, cb.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom cb
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = cb.assembly_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-T67U-54'

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive: expand any manufactured sub-assemblies
    SELECT cb.component_id, e.total_qty * cb.per_assembly_qty
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id
    JOIN current_bom cb ON cb.assembly_id = e.component_id
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.total_qty), 0) AS total_needed
FROM explosion e
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-2341';
```

    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'SE-R908'
),
assembly_ancestors AS (
    SELECT bom.assembly_id AS product_id
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN target_product tp ON bom.component_id = tp.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    UNION

    SELECT bom.assembly_id AS product_id
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    JOIN assembly_ancestors aa ON bom.component_id = aa.product_id
    WHERE bom.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_number
FROM assembly_ancestors aa
JOIN product p ON aa.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
ORDER BY p.product_number;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    SELECT
        bom.component_id,
        bom.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty
    FROM bill_of_materials bom
    WHERE bom.assembly_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-M63S-38')
      AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        bom.component_id,
        e.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = e.component_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_needed
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE component_id = (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2341');

    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'CR-7833'
),
canada_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= '2022-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2022-12-31'
),
order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.line_id, ol.product_id, ol.order_qty, co.order_date

    UNION ALL

    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bom.assembly_id = be.current_id

    JOIN u_composition c

    JOIN u_composition c

        c.parent_code AS ancestor_code,
        br.qty_factor * c.qty AS qty_factor,
        br.order_date
    FROM bom_reverse br
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON br.ancestor_code = c.child_code
     AND c.valid_from <= br.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR br.order_date <= c.valid_to)
),

        order_date,
        SUM(qty_factor) AS total_factor

    GROUP BY ancestor_code, order_date
)
